output.attribution_rationale: The trial compared AI generation plus individualized targets, detailed written guidance and clinician review against standard generic discharge advice.

achieved_dates.note: Methods give screening in January–March 2026, whereas results give December 2025–February 2026; outcomes were measured 30 days after discharge, placing both accounts within the window without establishing exact achieved dates.

conflict.note: The authors declare no competing interests; the disclosed foundation funding and hospital affiliations show no vendor conflict.

output.summary: The registered randomized trial supports improved short-term dietary target achievement from a bundled AI-assisted intervention in 90 patients. It does not isolate AI's contribution or establish clinical benefit, and its enrollment dates conflict.
